name: TODAY IS NOT TODAY
summary: Today is not Today is a project that aims to promote a cultural and educational use of new technologies—particularly virtual reality—applied to the languages of contemporary art. Its goal is to breathe new life into unfinished artworks, concepts that remained mere ideas, or projects once considered unfeasible due to technical, economic, or temporal limitations.
